mode.title: Mode
mode.description: forward：查证后用合并转发作答；silent：不回复（没有实际问题、不是在跟你说话或不该接的请求）；done：已经用操作类工具完成了请求（比如撤回），不再发消息

title.title: Title
title.description: mode=forward 时这次回复的主题（≤20 字）

silent_reason.title: Silent Reason
silent_reason.description: mode=silent 时一句话说明为什么不回（只记日志，不发出去）

BotReply.title: BotReply
BotReply.description: The structured answer of the chat / tldr agents.

Entry.title: Entry
Entry.description: One turn. Fields beyond ``kind``/``at``/``parts`` apply to some kinds only (noted per field).

ImagesDisplay.title: ImagesDisplay
ImagesDisplay.description: Images a tool produced or posted (render_*, sandbox show) rather than returned to the model.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: done：已用工具完成操作，不发消息；reply：回一段简短纯文本（查询结果、失败原因、需要澄清时）；handoff：不是管理操作，交给普通答疑（只在群聊里用）

text.title: Text
text.description: mode=reply 时发出的文字，纯文本，简短

OpsReply.title: OpsReply
OpsReply.description: The structured answer of the ops agent (``yggdrasil.ops.agent``).

OutputPart.title: OutputPart
OutputPart.description:
The run's structured output when the model returned it as text (native or prompted output mode) instead of
calling ``final_result``. Not stored: the admin API sets it when it reads a transcript.

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.description: 水位之后的新消息数（上限 10000）

body.title: Body
body.description: 省略则渲染当前生效版本

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: 模板引用的变量（默认模板与当前生效版本的并集）

QQContextDisplay.title: QQContextDisplay
QQContextDisplay.description: The user turn of an invocation: the group chat the prompt included, the quoted message and the trigger.

QQMessage.title: QQMessage
QQMessage.description:
A QQ message as it was when the run used it. ``segments`` are raw OneBot segments; the API adds ``src`` to
image segment data when it can serve the picture.

content.title: Content
content.description: 正文，纯文本，不要 markdown，不要加小标题；按意思分段，段落之间空一行

label.title: Label
label.description: 来源名称，如网页标题、文件名、#消息id

VerdictOut.title: VerdictOut
VerdictOut.description: A moderation verdict (``moderation.guard.Verdict``) as stored on invocations and review items.
